items.title: A proper modification that is an isomorphism outside a closed subscheme gives a fibre product decomposition of etale sheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the gluing statement for etale sheaves along a proper modification that is an isomorphism outside a closed subscheme: the sheaves on X are the fibre product of those on X' and Z over E (statement lines 23166-23183). The proof (proof lines 23185-23254) writes down the functor on triples, constructs the quasi-inverse as the fibre product f_*F' x_{i_*g_*g^{-1}G} i_*G using proper base change and the gluing isomorphism, and verifies both round trips by an explicit stalk computation, split into the cases x not in Z and x in Z with the identification E_z = X'_x. H2: an explicit construction plus a two-case stalk computation.
